about: docs/MEDIA.md describes this file. Put each file beside it and list it under its slot.

slots.title: Now Playing
slots.caption: The XivPiano window with a station playing: album art, title, artist and album, the progress bar and the bitrate, the station list on the left.

slots.title: In the Server Info Bar
slots.caption: The song's title in the server info bar at the top right, with its tooltip open: the artist, and click to open, right-click to pause.

slots.title: Thumbs, Tired and Why
slots.caption: Thumbs up turning green, then why this song? answered in Pandora's words under the controls, then tired of it skipping to the next song.

slots.title: A Station From a Search
slots.caption: Typing an artist into New station, picking a result, and the new station tuning in and starting its first song.

slots.title: Quiet for the Cutscene
slots.caption: A song playing over a zone with the game's music muted; a cutscene starts and the song pauses, then resumes when the cutscene ends and the game's music setting is as it was.

slots.title: /piano From a Macro
slots.caption: A macro with /piano next and /piano love on a hotbar, and the song announced in chat after it changes.
